set.title: Look into the dynamic query system, or whether the server loads all sessions and can query them by looping; owner recalls asking for this at one point.
set.description:
- Server side, in a cached way, compute all session costs, “maybe even in real time”.
- Keep instances of all sessions in memory; as new messages come in and costs are recalculated, update them so the grid renders properly.

complete.outcome: already built: The dynamic query system (ext/Query) exists, and the server holds every session snapshot in memory and answers the browser's row queries.
caveats: found by the closeout walk (Haiku read the repo); code checked the evidence exists
